text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — embeddings endpoint launch scope. customers repeatedly asking for 4096 dims + flexible batching. need API surface and gating decision today
Sam (Eng-Platform): for perf we can make 1024 the default. 4096 is feasible but ~2-3x cost/latency on same HW. suggest throttled opt-in via quota + per-tenant flag
Luca (Eng-ML): +1. model recommendations: open-embed-v1 (1024) should be default; open-embed-pro (4096) for high-fidelity. pro model uses larger knns and different normalization; semantics differ slightly
Sophia (Eng): implementation notes: supporting multiple dims in single request is a pain (variable tensor shapes). easier options: 1) single response dim per request (client picks) 2) per-request array of vectors but all same dim 3) accept mixed, server normalizes -> expensive
Ken (Product): a customer (FinApp) asked specifically for mixed-dim fallback during migration. they'd like a server-side adapter that up/down-projects for them
Sam (Eng-Platform): projection adapters are doable but add QA and quality risk. recommended: provide migration helper library + clear error code + suggested flow. if we expose auto-projection it should be opt-in and behind a feature flag
Maya (PM): launch criteria idea: (A) API schema stable (single-dim-per-request), (B) docs + migration guide for mixed dims, (C) perf profiles published for 1024/4096, (D) quota gating for 4096, (E) integration test with top 3 customers
Luca (Eng-ML): also add evaluation metrics: intrinsic similarity parity and downstream retrieval delta for projection path. we should block if projection causes >5% degradation on retrieval tests
Sophia (Eng): batching limits: we can support up to 1024 inputs per request for 1024-dims on hosted with continuous batching, but latency SLO might slip. propose default max_inputs=512, max_batch_size=2048 (server-side batching) and a per-tenant override for Dedicated
Ken (Product): response format: customers want compact JSON and optional base64 binary. default: { "data": [ {"id": "...", "embedding": [ ... ] } ] } and an opt-in binary payload with mime type application/x-embeddings-binary
Sam (Eng-Platform): binary option is fine, we'll add Content-Type negotiation. also need to define error behavior when request violates per-tenant quotas or mixed dims: 400 with structured error hint + docs link
Maya (PM): can we support streaming for huge batches? some customers want progressive results for UX
Sophia (Eng): streaming embeddings is unusual but we can stream chunked responses. complexity for ordering and retries — mark as stretch for GA, possible in v1.1
Luca (Eng-ML): model selection routing: default to open-embed-v1, fallback to pro only if tenant flag + capacity. routing policy should be explicit in API: ?model=open-embed-pro or omit to use default
Ken (Product): pricing note: 4096 should be priced at +X per 1k tokens equivalent. Legal wants clear TOS for data retention too
Maya (PM): decision table proposal: Default: 1024 JSON, max_inputs=512, allow binary opt-in, model param explicit, 4096 behind quota & feature flag, mixed-dim handled by client+migration guide. Blockers?
Sam (Eng-Platform): blocker: infra for per-tenant quota gating and billing differentiation not fully done. ETA 2 sprints unless we scope down (no quota gating at GA)
Sophia (Eng): blocker: embedding binary spec (endianness, float16 vs float32) — need to agree. prefer float32 little-endian with header + little complexity for clients
Luca (Eng-ML): we'll provide quantized float16 option later. show both float32 and float16 sizes in perf docs
Ken (Product): customers pushing for GA next month. can we do a limited GA with 1024 JSON only + migration docs and invite-only 4096?
Maya (PM): that aligns with risk. plan: GA1 = 1024 JSON public, invite-only 4096 + binary for partners. GA1 launch checklist: API schema doc, migration guide, perf benchmarks, billing hooks (basic), dedicated quota notes, 3 customer integrations. who owns each?
Sam (Eng-Platform): I'll own infra gating + billing hooks (deliver by sprint 3 for invite-only).
Sophia (Eng): I'll own binary spec + server encoding + tests.
Luca (Eng-ML): I'll own model docs + evals + projection guidance.
Ken (Product): I'll coordinate partner invites + pricing comms
Maya (PM): ok. action items: @Sam prototype gating, @Sophia draft binary spec, @Luca run projection evals (include failure case), @Ken list partner candidates. sync tomorrow 10:30am. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng-Platform): noted. will post a short tech proposal in #eng-platform after prototype
Sophia (Eng): will drop a gist of binary header and sample in the thread
Luca (Eng-ML): will attach evaluation notebook results to the PR
Ken (Product): will start partner outreach doc
Maya (PM): thanks all. moving this to a small RFC doc after our sync. meeting invite sent. :)
